tools.name: search
tools.description: Full web search for AI agents: ranked results with title, URL, snippet, domain and date, as Markdown or JSON. Costs $0.005 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP clients with an x402 wallet pay automatically). Free alternative with 3 titles: search_preview.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Clean Markdown of one public web page (title, description, language, main text), for reading or RAG. Costs $0.002 USDC per call on Base via x402.

tools.name: bids_search
tools.description: Open US public-sector bids and grants (state, county, city, school, housing authority, federal SAM.gov, Grants.gov): title, buyer, state, notice type, due date, number, codes, value and the official notice link. Up to 50 per call. Costs $1 USDC per call on Base via x402. Free titles-only sample: bid

tools.name: bids_preview
tools.description: Free: titles, state and due date of the 5 nearest open US government bids and grants matching your keywords. Buyer, link, number, codes and value come with the paid bids_search tool.

tools.name: search_preview
tools.description: Free web search preview: top 3 result titles and URLs. For full results with snippets use the paid search tool.

tools.name: index_status
tools.description: Size and freshness of the Search402 index, prices and payment network.

tools.name: how_to_pay
tools.description: Prices, wallet, network and the x402 payment steps, over MCP or plain HTTP.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_preview" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Free web search preview: top 3 result titles and URLs from the Search402 index. For full results with snippets, call the paid x402 endpoint given by how_to_pay." → after: "Free web search preview: top 3 result titles and URLs. For full results with snippets use the paid search tool."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
